name: Fathersland
source:
THERE ARE NEW THREATS TO HOME AND COUNTRY!

About 1,700 words in Super Videotome. Soundtrack by jaghatarkonst at BeautyWorld Records. Images from Wikimedia Commons and A Place Without Bodies - volume 1 by Colin Spacetwinks.
translation:
家园与祖国正面临全新的威胁！

基于Super Videotome引擎制作的约1700词短篇作品。原声配乐由BeautyWorld Records旗下的jaghatarkonst操刀；图像素材取自维基共享资源（Wikimedia Commons）以及科林·斯佩斯温克斯所著《无躯之地·第一卷》（A Place Without Bodies - volume 1）。
